text.text_excerpt: Stayed here for a week this past March (post-Mardi Gras), and had the most AMAZING experience. I was visiting friends, but needed a quiet place to stay for the majority of my trip, and couldn't have found a better place. The staff at the front desk were some of the nicest, most courteous, and professional people that I have ever worked with (sorry I forgot your names...I'm horrible with names!). The location of the hotel is IDEAL, as it is far enough away from the craziness of Bourbon Street (approximately 2 blocks or so), but close enough to the rest of the wonderful locations in the French Quarter. It is also right across the street from the Louis Armstrong Park/Congo Square, which was ...

We were just here for, "The Essence Festival". This was our 2nd stay at, "The Inn at St. Ann". Last year when I visited New Orleans, I was bummed that it was booked. I stayed at another hotel, "The Prince Conti, and the restroom had a heavy odor of urine even after housekeeping cleaned it several times.Anywho, We love The Inn at St. Ann, because it's beautiful and near Bourbon street. We can walk there in a flash. We can also walked to Cafe Dumond,and Ackmee House (our favorites). I adore this place,because it's not a small hotel with only a few rooms. If you have a vehicle I heard parkings not convient so you may need to rethink your choice.But, If you are looking for Vintage Charm then ...

The service was phenomenal, the everyone that worked there was so friendly! The location was so perfect so close to everything, 2 min walk from bourbon street but still was far enough away from the chaos helping me sleep at night! The hotel is very vintage and cute, the only thing I didn't like was that our room didn't have windows but other than that, Would recommend this place to stay
